description: CREATE (OR REPLACE) VIEW validation and durability: a failed replacement leaves the existing view (and materialized view) standing - the replacement is validated in full before anything is dropped; the body compiles FIRST (an unnamable+uncompilable body reports the compilation failure); the column checks speak for compilable bodies (Missing column specification / Invalid column definition list); a declared list names an unnamable item; body compile failures refuse CREATE with the select's own error (missing table/column, unknown function); a refused CREATE leaves nothing behind; and SHOW VIEWS lists created views. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CreateOrReplaceViewDurabilityTest, CreateViewBodyValidationTest and CreateViewTest (all now retired).
